title: pleopeltis pleolepis
intro: Pleopeltis pleolepis, commonly known as the resurrection fern, is a species of epiphytic fern native to the southeastern United States and the Caribbean. The health benefits of Pleopeltis pleolepis include its potential to reduce inflammation and oxidative stress, as well as its ability to promote wound healing and tissue regeneration. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. Bioactive constituents of Pleopeltis pleolepis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
